25% ([[Fallen Mode|Fallen]]) }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Versus''' was a mode where multiple players would fight against each other. The players were split into two teams, a red and blue team. You could pick a team by entering an [[Elevators|elevator]] with the team's respective color. The waves itself were the same as a standard Survival game, however, players had the ability to spawn enemies with {{Money|Cash}} as a way to defeat their opponent. These enemies were unlocked on specific wave. '''Versus''' had a significantly smaller selection of maps than Survival. The map chosen would be the same for each player. '''Versus''' victories were separate from Survival triumphs. Players could win by reducing their opponent's base health to zero. In the case of players losing at the same time, beating Wave 40 without any of the teams losing or all the players from one team leaving, there would be a draw. '''Versus''' mode allowed up to six players to be in each team. When a match started, players got to choose which mode they wanted to play. These modes were the same as survival modes, therefore, their wave structure and rewards will not be listed here. The enemies you could send were changed depending on the mode you have chosen. Before the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], up to four players could be in each team. As of 4th of March 2020, '''Versus''' mode has been removed from the game. As this mode was not played often, little is known about it. Because of this, some information on enemies may be missing. '''Versus''' mode was spiritually succeeded and replaced by [[PVP Test]] on the 18th of May 2024. It would be finally released as [[PVP]] on the 23rd of July 2025. ==Maps== ===Post-MEGA=== '''Versus''' mode used some of the maps that appeared in the Survival mode map rotation. {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:AutumnFalling.png|125px|link=Autumn Falling]] |[[File:ChessBoard.png|125px|link=Chess Board]] |[[File:DeadAhead.png|125px|link=Dead Ahead]] |[[File:Dusty Bridges.png|125px|link=Dusty Bridges]] |[[File:GrassIsle.png|125px|link=Grass Isle]] |- !Map |[[Autumn Falling]] |[[Chess Board]] |[[Dead Ahead]] |[[Dusty Bridges]] |[[Grass Isle]] |} ===Pre-MEGA=== '''Versus''' mode had maps specifically made for the mode.
